verses.sloka: नरान्तकं हतं दृष्ट्वा चुक्रुशुर्नैर्ऋतर्षभाः।देवान्तकस्त्रिमूर्धा च पौलस्त्यश्च महोदरः ।। ६.७०.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: narāntakaṁ hataṁ dṛṣṭvā cukruśurnairṛtarṣabhāḥ।devāntakastrimūrdhā ca paulastyaśca mahodaraḥ ।। 6.70.1 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the bulls among Rakshasas Naranthaka, Devanthaka, Trisira and Mahodara a scion of Paulastya and Mahodara, killed the Rakshasas cried aloud.
translations.hindi: सेना को मर्दन कर चुका था, मार कर अत्यन्त ॥ श्रीः ॥ श्रीसद्रामायणपारायणसमापनक्रमः श्रीवष्णवसम्प्रदाय: -+६० :-+ “एवमेतत्पुरावृत्तमाख्यानं भद्रमस्तु वः । प्रव्याहरत विस्रब्धं बलं विष्णोः प्रवर्धताम्‌

verses.sloka: आरूढो मेघसङ्काशं वारणेन्द्रं महोदरः।वालिपुत्रं महावीर्यमभिदुद्राव वीर्यवान् ।। ६.७०.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: ārūḍho meghasaṅkāśaṁ vāraṇendraṁ mahodaraḥ।vāliputraṁ mahāvīryamabhidudrāva vīryavān ।। 6.70.2 ।।

translations.english: Mahodara who closely resembled a cloud, mounted on the best of elephants chased brave and courageous son of Vali.

verses.sloka: भ्रातृव्यसनसन्तप्तस्तथा देवान्तको बली।आदाय परिघं दीप्तमङ्गदं समभिद्रवत् ।। ६.७०.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: bhrātṛvyasanasantaptastathā devāntako balī।ādāya parighaṁ dīptamaṅgadaṁ samabhidravat ।। 6.70.3 ।।

translations.english: Then, powerful Devanthaka who was immersed in grief of his brother, taking hold of a glowing iron bar rushed forward towards Angada.

verses.sloka: रथमादित्यसङ्काशं युक्तं परमवाजिभिः।आस्थाय त्रिशिरा वीरो वालिपुत्रमथाभ्ययात् ।। ६.७०.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: rathamādityasaṅkāśaṁ yuktaṁ paramavājibhiḥ।āsthāya triśirā vīro vāliputramathābhyayāt ।। 6.70.4 ।।

translations.english: Then Trisira, seated on the chariot, effulgent as the Sun, yoked to the best horse marched towards Angada.

verses.sloka: स त्रिभिर्देवदर्पघ्नैर्नैर्ऋतेन्द्रैरभिद्रुतः।वृक्षमुत्पाटयामास महाविटपमङ्गदः ।। ६.७०.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tribhirdevadarpaghnairnairṛtendrairabhidrutaḥ।vṛkṣamutpāṭayāmāsa mahāviṭapamaṅgadaḥ ।। 6.70.5 ।।

translations.english: Angada observed that all the three chiefs of Rakshasas, who were capable of crushing the pride of gods marching towards him and uprooted a huge tree.

verses.sloka: देवान्तकाय तं वीरश्चिक्षेप सहसा ऽङ्गदः।महावृक्षं महाशाखं शक्रो दीप्तमिवाशनिम् ।। ६.७०.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: devāntakāya taṁ vīraścikṣepa sahasā 'ṅgadaḥ।mahāvṛkṣaṁ mahāśākhaṁ śakro dīptamivāśanim ।। 6.70.6 ।।

translations.english: Just as Indra took a flaming thunderbolt, Angada, the hero took hold of huge branches of trees and hurled at Devanthaka with force.

verses.sloka: त्रिशिरास्तं प्रचिच्छेद शरैराशीविषोपमैः।स वृक्षं कृत्तमालोक्य उत्पपात तदा ऽङ्गदः ।। ६.७०.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: triśirāstaṁ praciccheda śarairāśīviṣopamaiḥ।sa vṛkṣaṁ kṛttamālokya utpapāta tadā 'ṅgadaḥ ।। 6.70.7 ।।

translations.english: Trisira split the trees with the arrows which were like venomous serpents. Observing Angada's action he flew up.

verses.sloka: स ववर्ष ततो वृक्षान् शैलांश्च कपिकुञ्जरः।तान् प्रचिच्छेद सङ्क्रुद्धस्त्रिशिरा निशितैः शरैः ।। ६.७०.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa vavarṣa tato vṛkṣān śailāṁśca kapikuñjaraḥ।tān praciccheda saṅkruddhastriśirā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।। 6.70.8 ।।

translations.english: Then the leader of the monkeys, rained trees and rocks. Angry Trisira attacked all of them with sharp arrows.

verses.sloka: परिघाग्रेण तान् वृक्षान् बभञ्ज च सुरान्तकः।त्रिशिराश्चाङ्गदं वीरमबिदुद्राव सायकैः ।। ६.७०.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: parighāgreṇa tān vṛkṣān babhañja ca surāntakaḥ।triśirāścāṅgadaṁ vīramabidudrāva sāyakaiḥ ।। 6.70.9 ।।

translations.english: Mahodara shattered those trees with the iron clubs. Trisira attacked brave Angada with arrows.

verses.sloka: गजेन समभिद्रुत्य वालिपुत्रं महोदरः।जघानोरसि सङ्क्रुद्धस्तोमरैर्वज्रसन्निभैः ।। ६.७०.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: gajena samabhidrutya vāliputraṁ mahodaraḥ।jaghānorasi saṅkruddhastomarairvajrasannibhaiḥ ।। 6.70.10 ।।

translations.english: Mahodara chased the elephant on to Angada in anger and attacked him on his chest with his iron clubs.

verses.sloka: देवान्तकश्च सङ्क्रुद्धः परिघेण तदा ऽङ्गदम्।उपगम्याभिहत्याशु व्यपचक्राम वेगवान् ।। ६.७०.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: devāntakaśca saṅkruddhaḥ parigheṇa tadā 'ṅgadam।upagamyābhihatyāśu vyapacakrāma vegavān ।। 6.70.11 ।।

translations.english: Then infuriated Devanthaka quickly came over Angada directly and attacked him with his iron club and retreated.

verses.sloka: स त्रिभिर्नैर्ऋतश्रेष्ठैर्युगपत् समभिद्रुतः।न विव्यथे महातेजा वालिपुत्रः प्रतापवान् ।। ६.७०.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tribhirnairṛtaśreṣṭhairyugapat samabhidrutaḥ।na vivyathe mahātejā vāliputraḥ pratāpavān ।। 6.70.12 ।।

translations.english: Eminent and highly energetic son of Vali did not feel perturbed when three of the foremost Rakshasas attacked him together.

verses.sloka: स वेगवान् महावेगं कृत्वा परमदुर्जयः।तलेन भृशमुत्पत्य जघानास्य महागजम् ।। ६.७०.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa vegavān mahāvegaṁ kṛtvā paramadurjayaḥ।talena bhṛśamutpatya jaghānāsya mahāgajam ।। 6.70.13 ।।

translations.english: Angada, who was endowed with high speed, and exceedingly difficult to encounter, jumped up the huge elephant of Mahodara attacked him.

verses.sloka: तस्य तेन प्रहारेण नागराजस्य संयुगे।पेततुर्लोचने तस्य विननाद स वारणः ।। ६.७०.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya tena prahāreṇa nāgarājasya saṁyuge।petaturlocane tasya vinanāda sa vāraṇaḥ ।। 6.70.14 ।।

translations.english: By that blow of Angada, that king of elephant's eyes dropped, and it cried.

verses.sloka: विषाणं चास्य निष्कृष्य वालिपुत्रो महाबलः।देवान्तकमभिप्लुत्य ताडयामास संयुगे ।। ६.७०.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: viṣāṇaṁ cāsya niṣkṛṣya vāliputro mahābalaḥ।devāntakamabhiplutya tāḍayāmāsa saṁyuge ।। 6.70.15 ।।

translations.english: Mighty son of Vali removed the tusk of the elephant and hit Devanthaka with it by jumping over him in the battlefield.

verses.sloka: स विह्वलितसर्वाङ्गो वातोद्धूत इव द्रुमः।लाक्षारससवर्णं च सुस्राव रुधिरं मुखात् ।। ६.७०.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa vihvalitasarvāṅgo vātoddhūta iva drumaḥ।lākṣārasasavarṇaṁ ca susrāva rudhiraṁ mukhāt ।। 6.70.16 ।।

translations.english: That astonishing Rakshasa shaken like a tree, thrown by the wind, shed huge amounts of blood which was of the colour of lacquer.

verses.sloka: अथाश्वास्य महातेजाः कृच्छ्राद्देवान्तको बली।आविध्य परिघं घोरमाजघान तदा ऽङ्गदम् ।। ६.७०.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: athāśvāsya mahātejāḥ kṛcchrāddevāntako balī।āvidhya parighaṁ ghoramājaghāna tadā 'ṅgadam ।। 6.70.17 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter the terribly strong Devanthaka taking iron spike quickly pierced Angada.

verses.sloka: परिघाभिहतश्चापि वानरेन्द्रात्मजस्तदा।जानुभ्यां पतितो भूमौ पुनरेवोत्पपात ह ।। ६.७०.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: parighābhihataścāpi vānarendrātmajastadā।jānubhyāṁ patito bhūmau punarevotpapāta ha ।। 6.70.18 ।।

translations.english: Then, hurt by the club the son of Vanara king fell down on his knees once again and got up.

verses.sloka: तमुत्पतन्तं त्रिशिरास्त्रिभिर्बाणैरजिह्मगैः।घोरैर्हरिपतेः पुत्रं ललाटे ऽभिजघान ह ।। ६.७०.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamutpatantaṁ triśirāstribhirbāṇairajihmagaiḥ।ghorairharipateḥ putraṁ lalāṭe 'bhijaghāna ha ।। 6.70.19 ।।

translations.english: While Angada was getting up, Trisira again hit him on the forehead with three straight going arrows.

verses.sloka: ततो ऽङ्गदं परिक्षिप्तं त्रिभिर्नैर्ऋतपुङ्गवैः।हनुमानपि विज्ञाय नीलश्चापि प्रतस्थतुः ।। ६.७०.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: tato 'ṅgadaṁ parikṣiptaṁ tribhirnairṛtapuṅgavaiḥ।hanumānapi vijñāya nīlaścāpi pratasthatuḥ ।। 6.70.20 ।।

translations.english: Then finding Angada surrounded by the three Rakshasa leaders, Hanuman as well as Neela set out.

verses.sloka: ततश्चिक्षेप शेलाग्रं नीलस्त्रिशिरसे तदा।तद्रावणसुतो धीमान् बिभेद निशितैः शरैः ।। ६.७०.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataścikṣepa śelāgraṁ nīlastriśirase tadā।tadrāvaṇasuto dhīmān bibheda niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।। 6.70.21 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Neela hit Trisira with the peak of the mountain and Ravana's son broke the mountain into pieces with arrows.

verses.sloka: तद्बाणशतनिर्भिन्नं विदारितशिलातलम्।सविस्फुलिङ्गं सज्वालं निपपात गिरः शिरः ।। ६.७०.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadbāṇaśatanirbhinnaṁ vidāritaśilātalam।savisphuliṅgaṁ sajvālaṁ nipapāta giraḥ śiraḥ ।। 6.70.22 ।।

translations.english: Hit by hundreds of arrows, the mountain peak broke into pieces of stones like sparks and flames fell from it.

verses.sloka: ततो जृम्भितमालोक्य हर्षाद्देवान्तकस्तदा।परिघेणाभिदुद्राव मारुतात्मजमाहवे ।। ६.७०.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato jṛmbhitamālokya harṣāddevāntakastadā।parigheṇābhidudrāva mārutātmajamāhave ।। 6.70.23 ।।

translations.english: Mighty Devanthaka, observing (Trisira's action), was happy on the battlefield, and went with his club to assault Hanuman.

verses.sloka: तमापतन्तमुत्प्लुत्य हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः।आजघान तदा मूर्ध्नि वज्रकल्पेन मुष्टिना ।। ६.७०.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamāpatantamutplutya hanumān mārutātmajaḥ।ājaghāna tadā mūrdhni vajrakalpena muṣṭinā ।। 6.70.24 ।।

translations.english: Then the son of wind god, Hanuman observing Devanthaka coming towards him, got up and hit him on the forehead with his thunderbolt like fist.

verses.sloka: शिरसि प्रहरन् वीरस्तदा वायुसुतो बली।नादेनाकम्पयच्चैव राक्षसान् स महाकपिः ।। ६.७०.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: śirasi praharan vīrastadā vāyusuto balī।nādenākampayaccaiva rākṣasān sa mahākapiḥ ।। 6.70.25 ।।

translations.english: When the heroic and strong son of the wind god hit on the head of Devanthaka, the Rakshasas trembled by the sound of the great monkey 's blow.

verses.sloka: स मुष्टिनिष्पिष्टविकीर्णमूर्धा निर्वान्तदन्ताक्षिविलम्बिजिह्वः।देवान्तको राक्षसराजसूनुर्गतासुरुर्व्यां सहसा पपात ।। ६.७०.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa muṣṭiniṣpiṣṭavikīrṇamūrdhā nirvāntadantākṣivilambijihvaḥ।devāntako rākṣasarājasūnurgatāsururvyāṁ sahasā papāta ।। 6.70.26 ।।

translations.english: Devanthaka's skull was shattered by the blow, and his teeth, eyes and tongue were forced out, the son of Rakshasa king fell dead on the ground.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् हते राक्षसयोधमुख्ये महाबले संयति देवशत्रौ।क्रुद्धस्त्रिमूर्धा निशिताग्रमुग्रं ववर्ष नीलोरसि बाणवर्षम् ।। ६.७०.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmin hate rākṣasayodhamukhye mahābale saṁyati devaśatrau।kruddhastrimūrdhā niśitāgramugraṁ vavarṣa nīlorasi bāṇavarṣam ।। 6.70.27 ।।

translations.english: Devanthaka, the foremost of Rakshasa warriors, an enemy of gods, endowed with great strength, having been killed in the conflict, Trisira became angry and rained arrows on Neela's chest.

verses.sloka: महोदरस्तु सङ्क्रुद्धः कुञ्जरं पर्वतोपमम्।भूयः समधिरुह्याशु मन्दरं रश्मिमानिव ।। ६.७०.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: mahodarastu saṅkruddhaḥ kuñjaraṁ parvatopamam।bhūyaḥ samadhiruhyāśu mandaraṁ raśmimāniva ।। 6.70.28 ।।

translations.english: Mahodara got enraged, mounted on an elephant just as the Sun went over Mandara mountain and went for war. Then Mahodara wielding bow rained arrows, just as rainy clouds with lightning and rainbows showers rain, on the mountain like chest of Neela.

verses.sloka: ततो बाणमयं वर्षं नीलस्योरस्यपातयत्।गिरौ वर्षं तडिच्चक्रचापवानिव तोयदः ।। ६.७०.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato bāṇamayaṁ varṣaṁ nīlasyorasyapātayat।girau varṣaṁ taḍiccakracāpavāniva toyadaḥ ।। 6.70.29 ।।

translations.english: Mahodara got enraged, mounted on an elephant just as the Sun went over Mandara mountain and went for war. Then Mahodara wielding bow rained arrows, just as rainy clouds with lightning and rainbows showers rain, on the mountain like chest of Neela.

verses.sloka: ततः शरौघैरभिवर्ष्यमाणो विभिन्नगात्रः कपिसैन्यपालः।नीलो बभूवाथ निसृष्टगात्रो विष्टम्भितस्तेन महाबलेन ।। ६.७०.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śaraughairabhivarṣyamāṇo vibhinnagātraḥ kapisainyapālaḥ।nīlo babhūvātha nisṛṣṭagātro viṣṭambhitastena mahābalena ।। 6.70.30 ।।

translations.english: Neela's body wetted by arrows all over, the limbs pierced with arrows, the monkey leader remained powerless and could not move in spite of being extraordinarily strong.

verses.sloka: ततस्तु नीलः प्रतिलभ्य सञ्ज्ञां शैलं समुत्पाट्य सवृक्षषण्डम्।ततः समुत्पत्य भृशोग्रवेगो महोदरं तेन जघान मूर्ध्नि ।। ६.७०.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatastu nīlaḥ pratilabhya sañjñāṁ śailaṁ samutpāṭya savṛkṣaṣaṇḍam।tataḥ samutpatya bhṛśogravego mahodaraṁ tena jaghāna mūrdhni ।। 6.70.31 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Neela also regained his senses and uprooting a mountain filled with trees went over Mahodara at high speed and attacked him on the forehead.

verses.sloka: ततः स शैलेन्द्रनिपातभग्नो महोदरस्तेन महाद्विपेन।विपोथितो भूमितले गतासुः पपात वज्राभिहतो यथा ऽद्रिः ।। ६.७०.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa śailendranipātabhagno mahodarastena mahādvipena।vipothito bhūmitale gatāsuḥ papāta vajrābhihato yathā 'driḥ ।। 6.70.32 ।।

translations.english: Then smashed by the impact of the mountain, along with his elephant Mahodara's body fell to the ground. Released from life, he fell like a mountain struck with lightning.

verses.sloka: पितृव्यं निहतं दृष्ट्वा त्रिशिराश्चापमाददे।हनुमन्तं च सङ्क्रुद्धो विव्याध निशितैः शरैः ।। ६.७०.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: pitṛvyaṁ nihataṁ dṛṣṭvā triśirāścāpamādade।hanumantaṁ ca saṅkruddho vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।। 6.70.33 ।।

translations.english: Trisira got enraged seeing his uncle killed, seized his bow and with a sharp arrow pierced Hanuman.

verses.sloka: स वायुसूनुः कुपितश्चिक्षेप शिखरं गिरेः।त्रिशिरास्तच्छरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्बिभेद बहुधा बली ।। ६.७०.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa vāyusūnuḥ kupitaścikṣepa śikharaṁ gireḥ।triśirāstaccharaistīkṣṇairbibheda bahudhā balī ।। 6.70.34 ।।

translations.english: The son of the wind god in anger hurled a top of the mountain on mighty Trisira, who split the mountain into several pieces with an arrow.

verses.sloka: तद्व्यर्थं शिखरं दृष्ट्वा द्रुमवर्षं महाकपिः।विससर्ज रणे तस्मिन् रावणस्य सुतं प्रति ।। ६.७०.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadvyarthaṁ śikharaṁ dṛṣṭvā drumavarṣaṁ mahākapiḥ।visasarja raṇe tasmin rāvaṇasya sutaṁ prati ।। 6.70.35 ।।

translations.english: Then seeing that the top of the mountain hurled was ineffective in that battle over Ravana's son, Hanuman discharged rain of trees.

verses.sloka: तमापन्तमाकाशे द्रुमवर्षं प्रतापवान्।त्रिशिरा निसितैर्बाणैश्चिच्छेद च ननाद च ।। ६.७०.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamāpantamākāśe drumavarṣaṁ pratāpavān।triśirā nisitairbāṇaiściccheda ca nanāda ca ।। 6.70.36 ।।

translations.english: Stupendous Trisira tore with his whetted arrows the rain of trees through the sky and roared.

verses.sloka: ततो हनूमानुत्प्लुत्य हयांत्रिशिरसस्तदा।विददार नखैः क्रुद्धो गजेन्द्रं मृगराडिव ।। ६.७०.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato hanūmānutplutya hayāṁtriśirasastadā।vidadāra nakhaiḥ kruddho gajendraṁ mṛgarāḍiva ।। 6.70.37 ।।

translations.english: Then Hanuman also jumped up in anger and tore the horse off Trisira just as the lion would tear the lordly elephant with nails.

verses.sloka: अथ शक्तिं समादाय कालरात्रिमिवान्तकः।चिक्षेपानिलपुत्राय त्रिशिरा रावणात्मजः ।। ६.७०.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: atha śaktiṁ samādāya kālarātrimivāntakaḥ।cikṣepānilaputrāya triśirā rāvaṇātmajaḥ ।। 6.70.38 ।।

translations.english: In the same manner, Trisira, the son of Ravana sprung up and seized a javelin, just as God of death in dark night and hurled at the son of wind god and shattered.

verses.sloka: दिवः क्षिप्तामिवोल्कां तां शक्तिं क्षिप्तामसङ्गताम्।गृहीत्वा हरिशार्दूलो बभञ्ज च ननाद च ।। ६.७०.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: divaḥ kṣiptāmivolkāṁ tāṁ śaktiṁ kṣiptāmasaṅgatām।gṛhītvā hariśārdūlo babhañja ca nanāda ca ।। 6.70.39 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the best of monkeys, snapped the javelin flung by Trisira on him, which came down unobstructed like a meteor from heaven and the monkeys roared.

verses.sloka: तां दृष्ट्वा घोरसङ्काशां शक्तिं भग्नां हनूमता।प्रहृष्टा वानरगणा विनेदुर्जलदा इव ।। ६.७०.४० ।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ dṛṣṭvā ghorasaṅkāśāṁ śaktiṁ bhagnāṁ hanūmatā।prahṛṣṭā vānaragaṇā vinedurjaladā iva ।। 6.70.40 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the dreadful form of shattered javelin, all Vanaras rejoiced and thundered like rain clouds.

verses.sloka: ततः खड्गं समुद्यम्य त्रिशिरा राक्षसोत्तमः।निजघान तदा व्यूढे वायुपुत्रस्य वक्षसि ।। ६.७०.४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ khaḍgaṁ samudyamya triśirā rākṣasottamaḥ।nijaghāna tadā vyūḍhe vāyuputrasya vakṣasi ।। 6.70.41 ।।

translations.english: Trisira, the foremost of Rakshasas then lifted his sword, placed it on the chest of Hanuman and dug into it.

verses.sloka: खड्गप्रहाराभिहतो हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः।आजघान त्रिशिरसं तलेनोरसि वीर्यवान् ।। ६.७०.४२ ।।
verses.transliteration: khaḍgaprahārābhihato hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ।ājaghāna triśirasaṁ talenorasi vīryavān ।। 6.70.42 ।।

translations.english: Heroic Hanuman hit by Trisira, attacked him with his palm on the chest.

verses.sloka: स तलाभिहतस्तेन स्रस्तहस्तायुधो भुवि।निपपात महातेजास्त्रिशिरास्त्यक्तचेतनः ।। ६.७०.४३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa talābhihatastena srastahastāyudho bhuvi।nipapāta mahātejāstriśirāstyaktacetanaḥ ।। 6.70.43 ।।

translations.english: Trisira, a highly energetic one, hit by Hanuman with his palm, dropped the weapon from his hand, lost his senses and fell on the ground.

verses.sloka: स तस्य पततः खड्गं समाच्छिद्य महाकपिः।ननाद गिरिसङ्काशस्त्रासयन् सर्वनैर्ऋतान् ।। ६.७०.४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tasya patataḥ khaḍgaṁ samācchidya mahākapiḥ।nanāda girisaṅkāśastrāsayan sarvanairṛtān ।। 6.70.44 ।।

translations.english: Taking the sword from Trisira, as he was falling, the great Vanara who resembled a mountain roared, creating terror in all, surrounded there.

verses.sloka: अमृष्यमाणस्तं घोषमुत्पपात निशाचरः।उत्पत्य च हमूमन्तं ताडयामास मुष्टिना ।। ६.७०.४५ ।।
verses.transliteration: amṛṣyamāṇastaṁ ghoṣamutpapāta niśācaraḥ।utpatya ca hamūmantaṁ tāḍayāmāsa muṣṭinā ।। 6.70.45 ।।

translations.english: Unable to bear that roar, that Rakshasa got up jumping and struck Hanuman with his fist.

verses.sloka: तेन मुष्टिप्रहारेण सञ्चुकोप महाकपिः।कुपितश्च निजग्राह किरीटे राक्षसर्षभम् ।। ६.७०.४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tena muṣṭiprahāreṇa sañcukopa mahākapiḥ।kupitaśca nijagrāha kirīṭe rākṣasarṣabham ।। 6.70.46 ।।

translations.english: The great monkey hit by the fist (of Trisira) became furious and in anger he got hold of Trisira's head with crown.

verses.sloka: स तस्य शीर्षाण्यसिना शितेन किरीटजुष्टानि सकुण्डलानि।क्रुद्धः प्रचिच्छेद सुतो ऽनिलस्य त्वष्टुः सुतस्येव शिरांसि शक्रः ।। ६.७०.४७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tasya śīrṣāṇyasinā śitena kirīṭajuṣṭāni sakuṇḍalāni।kruddhaḥ praciccheda suto 'nilasya tvaṣṭuḥ sutasyeva śirāṁsi śakraḥ ।। 6.70.47 ।।

translations.english: Enraged wind god's son, cut off the three heads of Trisira adorned with earrings just as Indra cut off the heads of Vishwarupa, son of Twashta.

verses.sloka: तान्यायताक्षाण्यगसन्निभानि प्रदीप्तवैश्वानरलोचनानि।पेतुः शिरांसीन्द्ररिपोर्धरण्यां ज्योतींषि मुक्तानि यथा ऽर्कमार्गात् ।। ६.७०.४८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tānyāyatākṣāṇyagasannibhāni pradīptavaiśvānaralocanāni।petuḥ śirāṁsīndraripordharaṇyāṁ jyotīṁṣi muktāni yathā 'rkamārgāt ।। 6.70.48 ।।

translations.english: The heads of Trisira, an enemy of Indra, resembling mountains with incongruous eyes glowing like Vyshvanara's eyes, fell into wilderness like stars fallen from the path of Sun.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् हते देवरिपौ त्रिशीर्षे हनूमता शक्रपराक्रमेण।नेदुः प्लवङ्गाः प्रचचाल भूमी रक्षांस्यथो दुद्रुविरे समन्तात् ।। ६.७०.४९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmin hate devaripau triśīrṣe hanūmatā śakraparākrameṇa।neduḥ plavaṅgāḥ pracacāla bhūmī rakṣāṁsyatho dudruvire samantāt ।। 6.70.49 ।।

translations.english: Trisira, the enemy of gods, endowed with the prowess of Indra got killed by Hanuman. The earth shook, the monkeys roared and the Rakshasas from all sides took to their heels.

verses.sloka: हतं त्रिशिरसं दृष्ट्वा तथैव च महोदरम्।हतौ प्रेक्ष्य दुराधर्षौ देवान्तकनरान्तकौ ।। ६.७०.५० ।।
verses.transliteration: hataṁ triśirasaṁ dṛṣṭvā tathaiva ca mahodaram।hatau prekṣya durādharṣau devāntakanarāntakau ।। 6.70.50 ।।

translations.english: Witnessing Trisira killed, earlier Mahodara also, Devanthaka and Naranthaka who are difficult to encounter killed, monkeys roared in joy seeing that Matta became very angry.

verses.sloka: चुकोप परमामर्षी मत्तो राक्षसपुङ्गवः।जग्राहार्चिष्मतीं घोरां गदां सर्वायसीं शुभाम् ।। ६.७०.५१ ।।
verses.transliteration: cukopa paramāmarṣī matto rākṣasapuṅgavaḥ।jagrāhārciṣmatīṁ ghorāṁ gadāṁ sarvāyasīṁ śubhām ।। 6.70.51 ।।

translations.english: Mahaparsva seized hold of a good venerable, allpowerful mace plated with gold, smeared with flesh and blood, shining with lustre, shining red with enemy's blood, an effulgent one whose head has been glowing decorated with red flower garlands that brought terror to Airavatam, Mahapadma, and Sarvabhuama, the three elephants guarding the three of the four quarters.

verses.sloka: हेमपट्टपरिक्षिप्तां मांसशोणितफेनिलाम्।विराजमानां वपुषा शत्रुशोणितरञ्जिताम् ।। ६.७०.५२ ।।
verses.transliteration: hemapaṭṭaparikṣiptāṁ māṁsaśoṇitaphenilām।virājamānāṁ vapuṣā śatruśoṇitarañjitām ।। 6.70.52 ।।

translations.english: Mahaparsva seized hold of a good venerable, allpowerful mace plated with gold, smeared with flesh and blood, shining with lustre, shining red with enemy's blood, an effulgent one whose head has been glowing decorated with red flower garlands that brought terror to Airavatam, Mahapadma, and Sarvabhuama, the three elephants guarding the three of the four quarters.

verses.sloka: तेजसा सम्प्रदीप्ताग्रां रक्तमाल्याविभूषिताम्।ऐरावतमहापद्मसार्वभौमभयावहाम् ।। ६.७०.५३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tejasā sampradīptāgrāṁ raktamālyāvibhūṣitām।airāvatamahāpadmasārvabhaumabhayāvahām ।। 6.70.53 ।।

translations.english: Mahaparsva seized hold of a good venerable, allpowerful mace plated with gold, smeared with flesh and blood, shining with lustre, shining red with enemy's blood, an effulgent one whose head has been glowing decorated with red flower garlands that brought terror to Airavatam, Mahapadma, and Sarvabhuama, the three elephants guarding the three of the four quarters.

verses.sloka: गदामादाय सङ्क्रुद्धो मत्तो राक्षसपुङ्गवः।हरीन् समभिदुद्राव युगान्ताग्निरिव ज्वलन् ।। ६.७०.५४ ।।
verses.transliteration: gadāmādāya saṅkruddho matto rākṣasapuṅgavaḥ।harīn samabhidudrāva yugāntāgniriva jvalan ।। 6.70.54 ।।

translations.english: Matta, the Rakshasa leader became very furious and took hold of the mace glowing like fire, at the time of dissolution of the universe and scattered the monkeys.

verses.sloka: अथर्षभः समुत्पत्य वानरो रावणानुजम्।मत्तानीकमुपागम्य तस्थौ तस्याग्रतो बली ।। ६.७०.५५ ।।
verses.transliteration: atharṣabhaḥ samutpatya vānaro rāvaṇānujam।mattānīkamupāgamya tasthau tasyāgrato balī ।। 6.70.55 ।।

translations.english: Rshaba, the bull among Vanaras endowed with prowess, springing up came and stood in front of Mahaparsva.

verses.sloka: तं पुरस्तात् स्थितं दृष्ट्वा वानरं पर्वतोपमम्।आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो गदया वज्रकल्पया ।। ६.७०.५६ ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ purastāt sthitaṁ dṛṣṭvā vānaraṁ parvatopamam।ājaghānorasi kruddho gadayā vajrakalpayā ।। 6.70.56 ।।

translations.english: Again, seeing Rshaba standing in front like a mountain, enraged Mahaparsva hit him on the chest with the mace that was like a thunderbolt.

verses.sloka: स तया ऽभिहतस्तेन गदया वानरर्षभः।भिन्नवक्षाः समाधूतः सुस्त्राव रुधिरं बहु ।। ६.७०.५७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tayā 'bhihatastena gadayā vānararṣabhaḥ।bhinnavakṣāḥ samādhūtaḥ sustrāva rudhiraṁ bahu ।। 6.70.57 ।।

translations.english: Hit in that way by the mace, Rshaba, bull of Vanaras, with chest broken, blood flowed excessively.

verses.sloka: स सम्प्राप्य चिरात् सञ्ज्ञामृषभो वानरर्षभः।अबिदुद्राव वेगेन गदां तस्य महात्मनः ।। ६.७०.५८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa samprāpya cirāt sañjñāmṛṣabho vānararṣabhaḥ।abidudrāva vegena gadāṁ tasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 6.70.58 ।।

translations.english: Regaining consciousness after a long time the monkey chief, Rshaba, was angry, his lips quivering as he was, ran to Mahaparsva.

verses.sloka: गृहीत्वा तां गदां भीमामाविध्य च पुनःपुनः।मत्तानीकं महात्मानं जघान रणमूर्धनि ।। ६.७०.५९ ।।
verses.transliteration: gṛhītvā tāṁ gadāṁ bhīmāmāvidhya ca punaḥpunaḥ।mattānīkaṁ mahātmānaṁ jaghāna raṇamūrdhani ।। 6.70.59 ।।

translations.english: The chief of the Vanaras, whose form was like a mountain, endowed with speed, got up quickly, duly, and forcibly hit the Rakshasa (Mahaparsva) in the space between his arms.

verses.sloka: स स्वया गदया भग्नो विशीर्णदशनेक्षणः।निपपात ततो मत्तो वज्राहत इवाचलः ।। ६.७०.६० ।।
verses.transliteration: sa svayā gadayā bhagno viśīrṇadaśanekṣaṇaḥ।nipapāta tato matto vajrāhata ivācalaḥ ।। 6.70.60 ।।

translations.english: Like a tree whose roots have been severed, the Rakshasa fell on the ground. Then seizing forcibly, the dreadful mace that resembled the rod of Lord of death he roared.

verses.sloka: विशीर्णनयने भूमौ गतसत्त्वे गतायुषि।पतिते राक्षसे तस्मिन् विद्रुतं राक्षसं बलम् ।। ६.७०.६१ ।।
verses.transliteration: viśīrṇanayane bhūmau gatasattve gatāyuṣi।patite rākṣase tasmin vidrutaṁ rākṣasaṁ balam ।। 6.70.61 ।।

translations.english: For a short while, Mahaparsva, the enemy of gods remained as if life had gone off up and struck the son of waters (Rshaba).

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् हते भ्रातरि रावणस्य तन्नैर्ऋतानां बलमर्णवाभम्।त्यक्तायुधं केवलजीवितार्थं दुद्राव भिन्नार्णवसन्निकाशम् ।। ६.७०.६२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmin hate bhrātari rāvaṇasya tannairṛtānāṁ balamarṇavābham।tyaktāyudhaṁ kevalajīvitārthaṁ dudrāva bhinnārṇavasannikāśam ।। 6.70.62 ।।

translations.english: The monkey was unconscious for a while having fallen on the ground. Regaining senses, overcoming, took up the mace which looked like the rock of a foremost mountain and struck him (Mahaparsva) on the battlefield.

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे सप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। ७० ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe saptatitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 70 ।।

translations.english: He (Rshaba) reached the body of the ferocious enemy of gods and brahmins. He split his chest with his mace and the timid Rakshasa shed blood just as Himalaya Mountain discharges water.
